name: stratscient
description: Your instant forward-deployed team in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Your people are the forward deployed. We're the instant firm behind them.

CerebrixOS is your instant forward-deployed team in ChatGPT: the capacity to do the work, the method to do it right, and a human expert when it matters.

Pick the outcome and CerebrixOS shows you exactly which files you'll get. You review and approve each job before it starts. Work is delivered as Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, with sources and assumptions documented.

What you can get:
- AI Transformation: process audits for AI and other opportunities, plus Ask Us Anything: straight answers to your questions from our team.
- Research & Intelligence: market sizing, industry landscapes, competitive benchmarking, company profiles and evidence packs from public sources.
- Business Consulting: business cases and decision-ready analysis.
- Financial Advisory & M&A: financial models, valuation work and due diligence checklists.
- Marketing & Communications: thought leadership and presentations.

Inside ChatGPT, CerebrixOS opens as a full app: your engagements with their team conversations, files, runs and knowledge, and your organization's members and access history. Jobs appear as cards in the chat, and you can @-mention an engagement or a company to bring it into the conversation. From any conversation you can open live chat or start a video call with your team in your browser.

Manage your organization, members and billing at https://cerebrixos.com.
defaultPrompt: Size the market for residential heat pumps in Germany
What does CerebrixOS know about Tim Hortons?

positive.description: Lists the signed-in person's engagements. The full CerebrixOS app opens with Open plugin on the plugin's page.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo organization's engagements, including "Coffee chain market entry (Canada)" with the reviewer's role (Manager).

positive.description: Reads recorded knowledge about a company, with its evidence.
positive.prompt: What does CerebrixOS know about Tim Hortons?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the confirmed facts about Tim Hortons in the demo organization, each with the conversation message or file it came from.

positive.description: Prepares a research job for approval without starting it.
positive.prompt: In the Coffee chain market entry (Canada) engagement, quote a market sizing report for coffee shops in Canada for 2026, for independent coffee shop chains.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for any missing details, then shows a job card with Approve or Start buttons. Nothing runs until the person starts it.

positive.description: Posts a message to the engagement's team conversation.
positive.prompt: Post "The draft is ready for review" in the Discussion conversation of the Coffee chain market entry (Canada) engagement.
positive.expected_behavior: The message appears in the Discussion conversation of that engagement under the reviewer's name.

positive.prompt: What has my CerebrixOS organization been charged for?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each paid job with its service, engagement, credits held and charged, and status.

negative.description: Buying credits is not offered in ChatGPT; the person manages their account on cerebrixos.com.
negative.prompt: Buy more CerebrixOS credits for me.

negative.description: Another organization's engagements are not accessible.
negative.prompt: Show me the engagements and files of Acme Corporation on CerebrixOS.

negative.description: Security settings such as the spending confirmation amount cannot be changed from a chat.
negative.prompt: Turn off CerebrixOS's identity check for large jobs.
